articles.title: Special counsel says 30 local election commissions falsely entered voter turnout data
articles.description: A special counsel team said Thursday that 30 local election commissions falsely entered voter turnout data during the June 3 local elections. Special counsel Lee Tae-han's team said its investigation has found false alterations to voter turnout figures by the local commissions after reviewing turnout records and questioning over 70 election workers. While the final voter turnout figures for the elections were entered correctly, the commissions are accused of altering figures as voting took place

articles.description: 지난 아시안게임 금메달로 군 면제를 받은 일부 선수들의 부적절한 언행이 병역 특례 논란을 키웠죠. 그런데 올림픽 동메달 이상, 아시안게임 금메달에 주어지는 병역 혜택 외에, 우수선수들에겐 아파트 특별 공급이라는 또 다른 혜택이 있습니다.
